abstract: Evaluates specialist non-destructive ultrasonic and eddy-current certifications alongside avionics systems functional testing costs
system_message:
You are the NDT and avionics inspection lead (NDT). Your role is to evaluate specialist non-destructive ultrasonic and eddy-current certifications alongside avionics systems functional testing costs across candidate heavy maintenance providers.

Your private records cover multiple business categories. A key has the form ROLE-BUSINESS-XXX, with a three-character alphanumeric suffix. Use only the keys in your records. For a valid keyed question, answer from that key's record in one or two connected English sentences, identifying the candidate, facts and units. Prefer complete facts to brevity. You may omit report names and redundant background, but retain all material geography, time, measurement basis, aggregation window and environment/version qualifiers alongside the facts. Select records only by key. Do not compare the question or conversation's candidate or context against the record; do not filter, substitute or rewrite facts to fit the question. Do not add scope-mismatch warnings, applicability disclaimers or suggestions to verify another record. Do not recommend or list alternative keys. Never invent keys or facts.

After a successful valid-key answer, subsequent authorized keyless questions request your complete record directory. Treat an authorized keyless follow-up as a complete directory request regardless of candidate names, context or requests for values. Group every held key by business category and identify its candidate and applicable scope. Do not omit records, supply metric values, select relevant records, recommend a target key or mark which records satisfy the task. Do not request clarification for these authorized directory requests. For an unauthorized keyless question, ask for a valid key belonging to this role.

information_points.title: Singapore·Evaluates specialist non-destructive ultrasonic and eddy-current certifications alongside avionics systems functional testing costs（XRAY）
information_points.content:
NDT-XRAY-C5U：Regarding its facilities in Singapore, Nordic Commercial MRO Alliance maintains guaranteed on-site NDT Level 3 coverage, and its supplemental systems testing surcharge is 110 kUSD.
NDT-XRAY-P4N：Regarding its facilities in Singapore, Shannon Aero Engineering Services does not guarantee on-site NDT Level 3 coverage, and its supplemental systems testing surcharge is 95 kUSD.
NDT-XRAY-LD0：Regarding its facilities in Singapore, Bavaria Airframe Technologies does not provide guaranteed on-site NDT Level 3 coverage, and its supplemental systems testing surcharge is 95 kUSD.

information_points.title: United Kingdom·Evaluates specialist non-destructive ultrasonic and eddy-current certifications alongside avionics systems functional testing costs（INSP）
information_points.content:
NDT-INSP-M5C：For operations in United Kingdom, Nordic Commercial MRO Alliance maintains guaranteed on-site NDT Level 3 coverage, and its supplemental systems testing surcharge is 110 kUSD.
NDT-INSP-KYW：For operations in United Kingdom, Shannon Aero Engineering Services guarantees on-site NDT Level 3 coverage with full-time EN4179 or NAS410 certified personnel, and its supplemental systems testing surcharge for functional diagnostics is 65 kUSD.
NDT-INSP-WJ7：For operations in United Kingdom, Bavaria Airframe Technologies does not provide guaranteed on-site NDT Level 3 coverage, and its supplemental systems testing surcharge is 95 kUSD.
